question: What cuts the bond supported by the arm in the pure kala-tattva?
premises: Thus, by order, in the pure kala-tattva.
The bond supported by the arm should be cut.
That kala is of the nature of opening some agency.
inference: The kala cuts the arm-supported bond in the pure kala-tattva by opening some agency.
uncertainties: The exact referent of the arm-supported bond is unclear.
The precise scope of the agency opened by that kala is unclear.
plain_english: Thus, in due order, in the pure kala-principle, the kala should cut the bond resting on the arm; for that kala is of the nature of opening some agency.
